children: Bally's reported $560 million of financing commitments for its Bronx, N.Y., casino and for general corporate purposes, and reaffirmed the planned early 2027 opening for a Chicago site.
The financing for the Bronx casino, led by WhiteHawk Capital Partners, includes closing date term loan commitments of $400 million and delayed draw term loan commitments of $160 million.
Chairman Soo Kim said later Monday in an update call that there have been inaccurate reports about the Chicago casino and he reiterated that the property is on track to open in early 2027.
Shares rose after the Monday morning financing news and ended the day up 7.3%, at $9.84. The stock had fallen sharply after an August securities filing that noted financing issues.

"This important financing allows us to progress the preconstruction planning process so that we are ready to complete the remainder of the capital raise and remain on schedule," Kim said earlier Monday.

On the update call, Kim said there was a "construction reset" for certain non-gaming elements in August, citing "uncertainty" that he said was created by Chicago's legalization of video gambling terminals in bars and restaurants.
Bally's now has a temporary Chicago location.
